request_subject: Public records request - 1928 Eastwood Avenue / PC-2025-80-CU
request_body:
Please provide electronic copies, if available, of existing records in the custody of the City of Akron or Clerk of Council responsive to the following matter: Planning case PC-2025-80-CU; Petition of David Walker / D-14; Conditional Use to Establish a Training Facility at 1928 Eastwood Avenue; proposed ordinance titled "authorizing a Conditional Use to establish a defense education training facility at 1928 Eastwood Avenue; and declaring an emergency." Date range: February 9, 2026 through August 25, 2026.

I am requesting: (1) any Clerk or Council index, docket, legislative-history, cross-reference, or status record assigning an ordinance or resolution number to this matter; (2) any introduced, substituted, amended, final, or executed ordinance or resolution document responsive to this matter; (3) any existing record reflecting final disposition or closure of this matter, including passage, rejection or denial, withdrawal, expiration, tabling, or another final Council action; and (4) any existing Clerk-maintained legislative-status record reflecting this matter's status as of August 25, 2026, if no final-disposition record exists.

This request seeks existing records only. It does not ask the City to create a new record, provide a legal conclusion, or answer an interrogatory.
